jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for a cozy isometric medieval town builder. Match the supplied villager sheet reference in painterly pixel art finish, dark clean contours, warm directional lighting and slightly chibi adult proportions. The reference is style only, not an edit target. Create a NEW single-character animation sprite atlas on genuine transparent alpha, no background, no shadows on ground, no text, no cell labels, no borders, no watermark. Landscape canvas 2048x1024, STRICT 8 columns by 4 rows, 32 isolated full-body sprites. Equal grid cells, generous fully transparent gutters of at least 12 pixels between cells, every weapon and effect fully contained inside its own cell. Equal character body height and consistent identity across all cells. Feet aligned at the same relative baseline in every cell. Each row is ONE direction: row 1 SE/front facing lower-right, row 2 SW/front facing lower-left, row 3 NW/back facing upper-left, row 4 NE/back facing upper-right. Columns in EVERY row: 1 idle upright, 2 walk left-foot forward, 3 walk passing pose, 4 walk right-foot forward, 5 walk opposite passing pose, 6 attack wind-up, 7 attack impact/release, 8 hurt/recoil leaning but feet on ground. Distinct readable movement and attack poses, not repeated identical figures. Weapon remains on the same anatomical side in every pose. No other characters or objects. Subject: royal human village guard, steel helmet and silver mail with a red tabard, leather boots, small red-and-gold shield on left arm, short steel sword in right hand. Columns 6 and 7 are sword raise and sword slash with shield braced. Friendly heroic guard, readable at 48px height.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production single-building sprite for a cozy isometric medieval town-builder, match reference watchtower image in warm detailed painterly pixel art, dark clean contours and no black outlines heavier than reference. Reference is style only. Single isolated complete building on genuine transparent alpha background, no scenery, no people, no text, no labels, no watermark, no ground shadow, no green base. Isometric/dimetric view with two ground axes at 2:1 slopes, front door faces bottom-left (southwest). Entire square ground footprint projects to a clean diamond, visible frontmost foundation corner near bottom centre; building centred horizontally, comfortably inside canvas with transparent padding on all sides. No cutoff roof tips, flags or stairs. Visually readable on a single 128x64 ground tile. Same compact square footprint and orientation for all three upgrade levels, taller/richer architecture at higher levels, not sprawling. Portrait or square canvas, native transparent PNG. Subject: royal guard training barracks, level 1 of 3. Identity: red banners with simple gold shield emblems, blue slate roof, stone and timber walls, front arched entry, small sword-and-shield rack fixed beside door. Level 1: modest sturdy timber barracks with pale stone foundation, one gabled blue slate roof and a single red pennant, simple exterior stairs.
